back_content.text: 公众天文观察与光污染。观察活动换到镇外，是为了减少街灯干扰。
back_content.explanation: 活动移到镇外的田野，因为街灯少，更容易看见暗淡的天体。若 thick cloud 遮住天空，活动会延期；换地点的原因和延期的条件是两件事。

tips: 分别记“换地点：灯光”和“延期：厚云”。

audio.transcript: The astronomy club has moved its public observation evening to a field outside town. The new site is less affected by street lighting, making faint objects easier to see. Transport will be provided from campus, and the event will be postponed if thick cloud prevents a useful view of the sky.
